review_results.evidence: The special response requires HTTP 400, RPC clued_authorization_manage_v12, p_input.op reduce, string SQLSTATE 22023, and the exact authorization_empty_projection_requires_binding_revoke message. It emits only a fixed business code and fixed public wording. Database details, hints, identifiers and arbitrary messages are never copied. Malformed JSON falls through to the existing redacted refusal.
review_results.qualification: Only these exact Worker bytes and this code portion are qualified for coordinated handoff; successor brand edits or a later main object require byte-level inheritance/review.

review_results.topic: Existing HTTP security and refusal routes
review_results.evidence: Origin, Owner bearer, operation and size gates are unchanged in the complete EEF delta. The RPC still forwards the actual Owner bearer with the publishable key; no gateway credential is substituted. Transient refusals retain 503; 401 and 409 retain their existing safe paths; other database refusals remain redacted 403.

The UI matches the controlled code only on HTTP 400, ignores server message/details, and renders fixed wording that the change was not saved. Rejection happens before submitted becomes true, so no success notice is emitted. The existing catch requires rereading and disables further writes. Reload and subsequent explicit revoke remain separate user actions. The delta adds no automatic revoke, repeated write, speculative grant change or implicit success.

review_results.topic: Copy-only order and signed selection preservation
review_results.evidence: Only human-facing range/grant and preview/grant maps wrap authorizationDisplayOrder. Selection creation, source/override identities and versions, environment, original signed view.selected, confirmation token/digest and payload functions are unchanged in the patch. The imported helper sorts a copied array; profile precedes global, while all project/context rows share the same rank and retain original order.

inherited_dependency.basis: Same exact helper bytes previously audited in R1, observed unchanged; not an expansion of the seven-file formal delta.

review_results.evidence: The UI test compiles and renders the actual page/shared module, passing through an actual Response for the refusal. It checks fixed wording, no diagnostics/no success, unchanged active binding/version, disabled revoke before reload, then exactly reduce and explicit revoke writes. The transport test bundles the actual Worker and maintained OAuth provider, with a deliberately limited HTTP database double; it checks the controlled refusal, private diagnostics redaction, wrong operation and wrong message. Existing actual transport cases preserve Owner bearer, Origin, CAS, size and safe 409 behavior.
review_results.qualification: The five-way predicate is completely checked statically; this new transport case does not independently execute every status/RPC/code/malformed-body mismatch. SQL authorization, whole browser E2E, and production are outside these HTTP/component proofs.

review_results.evidence: Decision v6 remains the source for personal records and profile-first display order. global/profile/project and precise context identities retain their compatibility meaning. The contract delta changes wording/order and adds scope-versus-level qualification; it does not change grants, operation ceilings, consent semantics or the historical accepted-r2 archive. No unadopted personal-space/notes/plans name is introduced.
